_comment: Offline storage / offline-accrual config for Echoes of Elarion. DATA the runtime interprets — NOT hardcoded branches (owner data-first style). Externalizes the tunables currently hardcoded on EchoService (BaseRatePerHour, SiloCapHours, MaxEchoes, resource split) and OfflineHarvestService (OfflineCapHours) into one authored table, and defines the storage-capacity UPGRADE LADDER that the offline-storage store packs sell against. Design doc: WorkOrders/WORK_ORDER_offline_storage_logic.md.

_sources.saveSchema: Assets/_Modules/Core/State/GameState.cs + SaveSchema.cs (v25 fields: SiloResources, LastHarvestClaimMs, EchoCount, WavesCompleted)

_schemaVersionNote: Bump GameState/SaveSchema to v26 ONLY if the new per-resource overflow fields below are adopted. The V1 shared-silo model already round-trips on v25 (SiloResources + LastHarvestClaimMs). See the save-model note in the design doc.
_modelNote: V1 = shared-silo (one pooled buffer measured in HOURS of accrual; matches live EchoService). 'per-resource' switches the runtime to the perResourceWarehouses table below (V2, flag ff.perresourcestorage). Runtime reads this string and picks the interpreter — no recompile to switch.

accrual._rateNote: Total accrual rate = activeEchoes * baseRatePerHourPerEcho (resources/hour). ratePerSecond = that / 3600. Echoes unlock via the wave pillar (every wavesPerEcho clears, up to maxEchoes).
accrual._splitNote: How a Dumped silo divides across the build harvestables. 'remainder:true' slot absorbs the integer rounding leftover so no unit is lost. Crystals are NOT in the silo split — they stay a premium/reward currency, banked only by mines/settlements/pets via OfflineHarvestService.

_capNote: siloBaseCapHours = the Echo silo buffer ceiling (absolute capacity = capHours * baseRatePerHourPerEcho * activeEchoes). offlineWindowBaseCapHours = the OfflineHarvestService away-window clamp for mine/settlement/pet nodes. Both are raised by the upgrade ladder below. Two dials, one ladder: a tier can lift one or both.

storageTiers.name: Woven Silo
storageTiers._note: Starting tier — every new save owns this. No cost; it is the baseline the ladder upgrades from.

storageTiers.name: Timbered Granary
storageTiers._note: First meaningful lift: 4h -> 6h silo, 10h -> 12h window. Soft-currency affordable within a session or two. SKR fast-track skips the grind.

storageTiers.name: Stone Reliquary Vault
storageTiers._note: 8h silo (a full work-day away pays off) + 16h window. Introduces a crystal cost so it gates behind some harvest depth.

storageTiers.name: Warded Hold
storageTiers._note: 12h silo / 24h window — the overnight check-in tier. The classic 'sleep, wake up full' loop lands here.

storageTiers.name: Eternal Heartstore
storageTiers._note: End-of-ladder soft-currency sink for committed players. 36h window means a weekend away still rewards. Premium fast-track for whales who want it now.

premium._currencyNote: SKR is the canonical premium token (wallet-rail, see packs.json pricing). skrFastTrack on each tier = the premium SKILL-SKIP cost to instantly own that tier instead of grinding soft currency. Convenience-only: it buys TIME (a bigger barn, sooner), never combat power — same covenant as the pack convenience items (instant-build / harvest-auto-collect).

fastForwardSilo.name: Spirit Surge
fastForwardSilo._note: Optional one-shot: instantly fill the silo to its current cap (skip the wait), priced in SKR. Maps to the packs.json 'harvest-auto-collect' convenience kind. Pure time-skip; the cap itself is unchanged.

packLinkedTiers._note: Offline-storage store packs grant a storageTier outright (or advance the owned tier). The pack catalogue (packs.json) references these tier ids in a future 'storage' contents slot. Buying a pack = owning that tier's cap permanently, no soft-currency spend.

perResourceWarehouses._note: V2 option (model:'per-resource', ff.perresourcestorage). Absolute per-resource holding caps for the SPENDABLE wallet (overflow past these is lost/refused on grant), independent of the time-based silo. Lets a pack sell 'Iron Vault +5000' style upgrades. Each warehouse has its own tier ladder mirroring storageTiers' cost shape. Inert in V1 (shared-silo).

saveModel._note: What persists. V1 needs NO new fields (already on GameState v25). The ownedStorageTier + per-resource tier indices are the ONLY additions, and they are small ints that fit the staged local->cloud->Solana save path (canon: data-architecture-hybrid-db-direction — config binaries stay OUT of the DB; only these scalar indices + balances sync).
existingFields_v25: SiloResources (double) — current pooled silo balance, pre-Dump
LastHarvestClaimMs (double, Unix-ms) — the accrual clock; offline delta = now - this; advanced atomically on Dump/claim
Resources { wood, iron, food, crystals, coins } — the spendable wallet

newFields_v26.desc: Index into storageTiers; runtime applies that tier's siloCapHours + offlineWindowCapHours. Replaces the hardcoded EchoService.SiloCapHours / OfflineHarvestService.OfflineCapHours.
Only used when model='per-resource'. Index into each perResourceWarehouses[].tiers.
